name: Skill Creator
description: Use when the user asks to create a skill from scratch, write a custom skill, turn a runbook/process into a reusable skill, clone or install a skill from a git repository, skill marketplace, or archive link, port an existing skill to Hivy, or organize the org's custom skills into plugins. From scratch: design the workflow with the user (or by doing the task once), write it, test it. From an external source: install in the sandbox, security-scan (prompt injection, malicious scripts, exfiltration), study, adapt to the Hivy sandbox (browser CLI, /workspace persistence, org environment variables, no docker). Both paths: dry-run every script, get explicit user approval, publish with create_skill, then hand off to an admin to enable the plugin for the team.
human_description: Creates custom skills from scratch, or import an existing skill.
